axis_selection: The agent selected its own axis per the brief. The PRUNE 2-3 px annulus is the only unsampled interior of the collar curve (R0 is the 2 px point; PRUNEp3px jumps to 3 px), and PRUNE is the section 4.4 exception under which sub-3 px collars are gate-legal. Every other brief axis already has multiple R0/R1 arms.

p3px.evidence_class: MODEL (prior registry projection, not a live score)

p4px.evidence_class: MODEL (prior registry projection, not a live score)

p4.3px.evidence_class: MODEL (prior registry projection, not a live score)

predictions_are: MODEL, not scores; any live absolute delta < 0.01 is no evidence
treatment: For each value, remove every R0 dot at d_catalogue <= threshold_px; hold N=37,654; add the same number from the original H19-5 support at d_catalogue > threshold_px using exact greedy expected-DTI marginal gain. All other settings and the fixed physical-field ranking recipe are unchanged.
refill_ranking_basis: Exact iterative marginal expected-DTI gain via vendor/gems57/metric.py and scripts/build_prune_variants.py::select_exact_marginal_dti_add; candidate pool is the original H19-5 binary support outside the threshold; fixed label-free physical field across all variants; no isolated-pixel shortcut or random tie score
physical_field: label-free four-line physical field from scripts/build_prune_variants.py: surface scarp, subsurface potential-field, strain/seismic, and hydrothermal lines; all single-channel canaries must be <= 0.90 before the field is used

variants.band: inner annulus fringe only (d_cat = sqrt(5) px)
variants.prediction_basis: Linear interpolation R0(0 removed -> 0.000) to PRUNEp3px (2,171 removed -> MODEL +0.005): 0.005 * 941 / 2,171 = +0.0022, rounded +0.002.
variants.hypothesis: The 941 R0 dots on the innermost catalogue fringe (224 m, one to two pixel centres beyond R0's 200 m collar) are dominated by catalogue-parallel potential-field side-lobes rather than unmapped fault tips; purging only this fringe and refilling on independent H19-5 ridges recovers a small positive share of the full 300 m purge's benefit while disturbing under 2.5% of dots.

variants.band: inner + outer annulus fringe (d_cat <= sqrt(8) px); leaves the 3.0 px ring
variants.prediction_basis: Linear interpolation R0 to PRUNEp3px: 0.005 * 1,611 / 2,171 = +0.0037, rounded +0.004.
variants.hypothesis: Purging both sub-kernel-radius fringes (1,611 dots, 224-283 m) but retaining the 560 dots that sit at exactly one kernel radius (300 m) captures most of R1's annulus treatment; if annulus toxicity is uniform with distance, this arm should sit close to R1's MODEL +0.005 at a smaller edit, whereas toxicity concentrated on the 300 m ring would leave it close to R0.

variants.band: upper collar bracket beyond the measured p4.3px (430 m) point
variants.prediction_basis: Linear extrapolation of the descending limb through p4px (3,825 removed, -0.009) and p4.3px (4,488 removed, -0.013): slope -6.03e-6 per dot; at 5,637 removed -> -0.0199, rounded -0.020. Extrapolation outside the measured bracket; range widened accordingly.
variants.hypothesis: A 500 m collar (1.67 kernel radii; beyond the 400 m GeoDAWN flight-line spacing) removes genuine relay/step-over splays and antithetic strands of the known systems -- the 'new geometry of existing systems' the organizer includes in new-fault truth -- faster than exact-marginal refill can replace them, so the live DTI loss deepens the measured p3.7 -> p4.3 descent.
